verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Okta exposes RESTful APIs for user/group CRUD via SCIM and outbound REST event hooks, plus a documented rate-limits page implying API governance, but nothing in the pack directly documents the core Users/Groups/App-assignments Management API with pagination and filtering, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec. missing for 10: explicit Users/Groups/App-assignments REST API docs, documented pagination/filtering parameters, and a public OpenAPI spec.
